context_endpoints_sibling_overlap.note: Contextual yield and soil_EC endpoints from the core reclamation synthesis corpus are reported for denominator auditing and paired diagnostics only (omitted from main hydraulic models).

dual_pathway_hydraulic_vs_ec.sign_convention_note: Negative soil_EC lnRR indicates salinity reduction (mean Arm B soil_EC lnRR = -0.251); a negative slope/correlation implies larger hydraulic gain associates with stronger EC reduction, whereas P > 0.45 indicates no monotonic statistical coupling.

esp_meta_regression.anomaly_note: Rows with initial_esp_pct > 100% are physically impossible ESP values (one family at 185.5%); physical_domain_esp_le_100 is the primary result and all_rows_incl_esp_gt100_anomaly is a labelled anomaly sensitivity.
